summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Arbe Robotics Ltd., a foreign private issuer, furnishing a press release of its Q1 2026 financial results and announcing a conference call to discuss the results. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is described. The filing is routine quarterly reporting and a call notice, not a special situation.
